feature: ShaneBot Active Cards - invoice/subscription/score/data-answer cards rendered inline in the real artifacts/portal chat shell (/support, support.tsx), driven by card_router + customer_entitlements grounding's cardData (shanebot-engine.ts). Supersedes the #366 manifest's prior assumption of a portal-v2 support-chat.tsx surface - portal-v2 is retired (see CLAUDE.md); this is the real #2519 build against the fresh artifacts/portal scaffolding (#1673).
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the real, deterministic surface of #2519/#366 - that POST /api/msp/support/chat is auth-gated, that a logged-in customer gets a real structured response (content block array), and a real UI walk of the chat surface itself: the route mounts, the message input/send controls are real, and sending a turn renders a real assistant reply bubble (support-chat-latest-reply, ChatBubble.tsx:34).

WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (card non-determinism): whether a [SHOW_CARD:x] marker (and therefore an actual `{type:'card',...}` block) appears in any given reply is a live-model judgment call (claude-haiku-4-5 deciding, per-turn, whether the user's question warrants a card) - it cannot be forced or seeded, the same class of non-determinism already documented for /api/quiz/submit (MEMORY: quiz-scoring-no-deterministic-endpoint). A UI/API step asserting 'a card renders for this exact prompt' would be flaky by construction, so it is not attempted here. Instead: card_router's parse/gate/strip, the customer_entitlements builder's cardData assembly (invoice/subscription/score/data-answer, real DB rows), and the full propose-resolve-strip flow in the /msp/support/chat handler all have full DETERMINISTIC unit coverage with a mocked model reply: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/shanebot-engine.test.ts and artifacts/api-server/src/routes/support-chat.test.ts.

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED (#2991, Feature #1648) - login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid, so this manifest drives a real login and a real send-a-turn round trip through the browser instead of only asserting the pre-auth honest empty state (Git #4104 - this note previously said no login page existed yet; that premise was stale).

ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other msp-portal manifests use).
logger channel for the endpoint under test: `engine.shanebot`.

Git #4104 (2026-09-14): this manifest's real loginAs + authenticated-uiSteps rewrite was validated indirectly rather than by directly invoking shaneapp://runTest against THIS file - BuildConsole's dev-server checkout still resolves the pre-#4104 file (the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/team-management.json's own #4104 note documents with direct live evidence). Instead, the identical pattern (top-level loginAs, goto the real route, expect a real data-testid) was verified live against test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json - an already-merged sibling using this exact mechanism - via a real shaneapp://runTest invocation from this build session: real login succeeded, the real goto navigated correctly, and the real testid-based expect assertions ([data-testid='risk-row-toggle-RBD-2026-104'], [data-testid='policy-decision-row-RBD-2026-104']) genuinely passed in this live BuildConsole/WebView2 environment (18/21 steps passed; the 3 failures are pre-existing content-drift already in that file, unrelated to and not touched by this build). Re-run this manifest directly via shaneapp://runTest once this branch merges to the dev-server checkout.
